name: Wealthfolio Companion
description: Fetches transactions from your brokers and writes them, deduplicated, into your self-hosted Wealthfolio. Set up entirely in the web UI over HTTPS; everything it stores is encrypted, optionally with a master passphrase.

notes.text: Open the web UI after the installation; the first visit asks you to choose a password with the setup code the installation shows, then a checklist on the overview shows what is left to set up.
Forgot the web UI password? Run `companion-reset-password` in the container console.

The web UI (https://<ip>:8443) uses a certificate of the container's own CA: confirm the browser warning once, or import /ca.crt (page Sicherheit) so browsers trust it. Plain http on port 8090 redirects there.
With a master passphrase set, the service has to be unlocked in the web UI after every restart of the container. Without the passphrase the data can't be recovered.
